title: A bone on Mars in a JPL negative

tellings.quote: this is a bone on Mars

plain: Joe McMoneagle tells Michels that a photographic negative from the Mars mapping work of the Jet Propulsion Laboratory, NASA's centre for robotic space missions, shows a bone lying on Mars. He says he has looked at the image himself and states flatly, "this is a bone on Mars." If he were right, something with a skeleton once lived there.
